meta.name: minimalist-ui
meta.description: Clean editorial-style interfaces. Warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels. No gradients, no heavy shadows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建干净、编辑风格的界面设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要简洁、温暖、无阴影的界面风格。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clean, warm, shadowless interface style.

howto.what: 装好后,当 Claude 写前端代码或做页面布局时,会产出编辑杂志风格的极简界面:暖调单色底、强字体对比、扁平 bento 网格和淡彩点缀,并避开渐变、重阴影、Inter/Roboto 等常见默认。
howto.when: 当你请它写 HTML、React、Tailwind 等前端代码,或设计页面布局时触发。

say.text: 用这套极简编辑风做一个产品首页,bento 网格布局
say.note: 按暖调单色与扁平卡片产出代码

say.text: 把 hero 区改成衬线标题配无衬线正文,收紧字距
say.note: 套用规范里的排版层级

say.text: 检查这些卡片和分割线是否符合 1px #EAEAEA

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude produces editorial-style minimalist interfaces for frontend code and layouts: warm monochrome canvas, strong typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastel accents, no gradients or heavy shadows.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for frontend code (HTML, React, Tailwind, etc.) or a page layout design.

say_en.text: Build a product homepage in this minimal editorial style with a bento grid
Swap this hero to a serif headline with sans body and tighter tracking
Check whether these cards and dividers follow the 1px #EAEAEA rule
